post.description:
Multi-step agent configuration endpoint. Use this after agent creation (via /agent-context and /agent-creation).

**GENERATE_SOP**: Generates Standard Operating Procedures for the agent
- Required: agentId, query
- Returns: nextStep (GRAPH_GENERATION)

**GRAPH_GENERATION**: Creates agent workflow graph
- Required: agentId
- Returns: nextStep (TOOL_MATCHING)

**TOOL_MATCHING**: Matches existing tools to agent needs
- Required: agentId
- Returns: nextStep (TOOL_GENERATION)

**TOOL_GENERATION**: Generates new custom tools if needed
- Required: agentId
- Returns: nextStep (TOOL_INTEGRATION)

**TOOL_INTEGRATION**: Integrates selected tools with the agent
- Required: agentId
- Returns: nextStep (UPDATE_AGENT)

**UPDATE_AGENT**: Finalizes and updates the agent configuration
- Required: agentId
- Returns: nextStep (AGENT_UPDATED)

Note: Use /agent-context first to get threadId, then /agent-creation to create the agent and get agentId before using this endpoint.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp when the tool was deleted.

nodeObjective.description: The objective or purpose of this node in the agent graph
nodeObjective.example: Extract customer data from the provided CSV file

agentId.description: The ID of the agent to get custom GPT tool optimization analytics for

improvementCount.description: Number of custom GPT tools with accuracy score less than 0.90 (needing improvement)

activeOptimizations.description: Number of currently active/ongoing optimizations for custom GPT tools

averageToolAccuracy.description: Aggregated accuracy metric across all custom GPT tools

prompts.description: List of suggested prompts shown to users as conversation starters. These help users understand what the agent can do
example: What is the current Bitcoin price?
Can you fetch the latest cryptocurrency rates?

conditionType.description: Type of condition evaluation (llm_based or rule_based)

llmModel.description: The LLM model to use for condition evaluation

fallbackModels.description: Comma-separated fallback models for condition evaluation

timeToWaitUnit.description: The unit of time for the wait duration

linkedAgentGraphNodeId.description: Custom id of the node linked to this node (e.g., source node for a variable-based loop, or the node a waiting node is linked to). The server resolves it to the persisted node id.

timeoutType.description: Timeout type for the waiting node

timeoutUnit.description: The unit of time for the timeout duration

onTimeout.description: Action to take when timeout is reached (continue or fail)

iterationCount.description: Number of iterations for a count-based loop (looping node only).

linkedVariableId.description: Output parameter to loop over for a variable-based loop (looping node only). Supply as "<sourceNodeCustomId>:<paramName>"; the server resolves it to the output param id.

alias.description: Alias for nodes inside a looping node.

label.description: Display label shown to users when selecting this option in a dropdown or selection UI

value.description: The actual value submitted when this option is selected, typically used in API calls or data processing

fillType.description: Determines how the parameter value is populated. Options: "ai_fill" (AI determines value), "static" (fixed value), "linked" (from previous node output), "user_input" (user provides value)

position.description: The display order position of this parameter (0-indexed). Lower numbers appear first in the UI

question.description: When fillType is "user_input", this question is displayed to prompt the user for input
question.example: What API endpoint URL should be used?

linkedOutputParamNodeId.description: When fillType is "linked", this is the node ID that contains the output parameter to link to

linkedOutputParamName.description: When fillType is "linked", this is the name of the output parameter from the referenced node to link to

staticValue.description: When fillType is "static", this is the fixed value that will always be used for this parameter

required.description: Whether this parameter must be provided for the tool to execute. Required parameters must have a value

dataType.description: The expected data type for this parameter. Common types: string, number, boolean, object, array

outputExample.description: An example value showing the expected format, helpful for AI or users when providing input

reloadProps.description: When true, changing this parameter value triggers a reload of dependent parameters or options

remoteOptions.description: When true, the available options for this parameter are fetched from an external API rather than being static

options.description: For dropdown/select parameters, the list of available options to choose from

paramName.description: The technical name/key of this parameter, used in API calls and data mapping

paramDescription.description: Human-readable description explaining what this parameter is for and what value is expected
paramDescription.example: The URL of the API endpoint to call

paramTip.description: Additional helpful tip or hint displayed in the UI to guide users when filling this parameter
paramTip.example: Make sure to include the full URL with protocol (https://)

linkedOutputParamRules.description: Array of linked output param rules for conditional input resolution

linkedParamRulePrompt.description: Prompt for the linked param rule (used with LLM-based conditions)

linkedParamConfigurations.description: Configuration for linked param condition (conditionType, llmModel)

isArray.description: Whether this output parameter returns an array of values rather than a single value

paramName.description: The technical name/key of this output parameter, used when accessing the value in subsequent nodes

position.description: The display order position of this parameter (0-indexed). Lower numbers appear first in the UI

paramDescription.description: Human-readable description explaining what this output contains and how it can be used
paramDescription.example: The current price of Bitcoin in USD, extracted from the API response

parentId.description: For nested/hierarchical outputs, the UUID of the parent parameter. Null for top-level parameters

paramPath.description: JSON path showing where this value is located in a nested response structure

outputExample.description: Example value demonstrating the expected output format

dataType.description: The data type of this output. Common types: string, number, boolean, object, array

typeOptions.description: Additional type configuration (e.g., enum values, format specifications, nested structure definitions)

toolFunctionName.description: The unique function name used to invoke this tool

toolName.description: The display name of the tool shown in the UI

iconSrc.description: URL to the tool icon image

description.description: Brief explanation of what this tool does
description.example: Fetches the current Bitcoin price from CoinGecko API and returns the USD value

requiresConsent.description: When true, the agent will ask for user confirmation before executing this tool

isMemoryTool.description: When true, this tool can access and search the agent memory/knowledge base

memoryLookupInstruction.description: Instructions for how to search the memory when isMemoryTool is true

isBackgroundTool.description: When true, the tool runs in the background without blocking the conversation flow

isBatchExecutionEnabled.description: When true, the tool can process multiple items in a single execution (batch mode)

accuracyScore.description: A score (0-100) indicating the historical accuracy/success rate of this tool. Null if not yet measured

preferredModel.description: The preferred AI model to use when executing this tool. If not specified, the system default model will be used. Common values: "gpt-4", "gpt-4o", "gpt-3.5-turbo"

fallbackModels.description: Comma-separated list of fallback models. No spaces allowed.

prompt.description: The prompt template that guides the AI when executing this tool. This defines how the AI should process inputs and generate outputs. Required for custom GPT tools
prompt.example: You are a helpful assistant. Given the input parameters, fetch the current Bitcoin price and return it in a user-friendly format.

inputParams.description: List of input parameters that define what data this tool needs to execute. These can be filled by AI, static values, user input, or linked from previous node outputs

outputParams.description: List of output parameters that this tool produces after execution. These outputs can be linked to input parameters of subsequent nodes in the graph

sourceNodeId.description: The node ID containing the source output parameter

sourceOutputParamName.description: The name of the source output parameter to compare

comparisonValueType.description: Type of comparison value (static or output_param)

comparisonValue.description: Static value to compare against (when comparisonValueType is static)

comparisonNodeId.description: Node ID containing the output param to compare against (when comparisonValueType is output_param)

comparisonOutputParamName.description: Output param name to compare against (when comparisonValueType is output_param)

nextRuleOperator.description: Logical operator to connect to the next rule (AND/OR)

nextGroupOperator.description: Logical operator to connect to the next group (AND/OR)

sourceAgentGraphNodeId.description: The UUID source node where this edge originates from (the "from" node)

targetAgentGraphNodeId.description: The UUID of the target node where this edge leads to (the "to" node)

condition.description: A condition expression that must evaluate to true for the agent to follow this edge. Empty string means unconditional transition

isAttachmentDataPulledIn.description: When true, any file attachments from the conversation are passed along this edge to the next node

conditionGroups.description: Condition groups for rule-based condition evaluation

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID). This ID is used to reference the node in edge connections (sourceAgentGraphNodeId/targetAgentGraphNodeId)

objective.description: The goal or purpose of this node - what the AI should accomplish when it reaches this step. This is the main instruction for the node
objective.example: Fetch the current Bitcoin price and return it to the user in a friendly format

evaluationCriteria.description: List of criteria used to evaluate if the node executed successfully. Each criterion is checked after node execution
example: The response contains a valid price number

isEntryNode.description: When true, this is the starting node of the graph. The agent begins execution here. Each graph must have exactly one entry node

isExitNode.description: When true, reaching this node ends the graph execution. A graph can have multiple exit nodes for different outcomes

nodeType.description: The type of node (executionNode, conditionNode, entryNode, exitNode)

nodeConfigurations.description: Configuration options for condition nodes (conditionType, llmModel)

xCoordinate.description: Horizontal position (in pixels) of the node in the visual graph editor UI

yCoordinate.description: Vertical position (in pixels) of the node in the visual graph editor UI

isEvaluationEnabled.description: When true, the node output is evaluated against the evaluationCriteria after each execution

isAttachmentDataPulledIn.description: When true, any file attachments in the conversation are made available to this node during execution

onError.description: Defines what happens when the node encounters an error. Options: "STOP" (halt execution), "CONTINUE" (proceed to next node)

autoRetryWhenAccuracyLessThan.description: When enableAutoRetryWhenAccuracyIsLow is true, the node will retry if the accuracy score falls below this threshold (0-100)

autoRetryLimitWhenAccuracyIsLow.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when the accuracy is below the threshold

autoRetryCountWhenFailure.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when the node execution fails with an error

autoRetryWaitTimeWhenFailureInMs.description: Time to wait (in milliseconds) between retry attempts after a failure

enableAutoRetryWhenAccuracyIsLow.description: When true, automatically retry the node if the accuracy score is below autoRetryWhenAccuracyLessThan

enableAutoRetryWhenFailure.description: When true, automatically retry the node if execution fails with an error

toolConfiguration.description: The tool configuration for this node. If the node needs to execute a specific tool (like calling an API), configure it here. Nodes without tools are handled by the AI directly

parentNodeId.description: The customId of the parent loop node when this node is a child inside a loop. Used to associate loop body nodes with their parent loop.

childEdges.description: List of edges that go OUT from this node to other nodes. Each edge defines a possible path the agent can take after completing this node

parentEdges.description: List of edges that come IN to this node from other nodes. These represent the paths that lead to this node from previous steps

agentName.description: The name of the agent to be created. This will be displayed in the UI and used to identify the agent

agentDescription.description: A detailed description of what the agent does and its capabilities
agentDescription.example: An AI agent that fetches real-time cryptocurrency prices and provides market insights

settings.description: Configuration settings for the agent including personality, restrictions, and suggested prompts

nodes.description: The complete list of nodes that make up the agent workflow graph. Nodes are connected by edges to form the execution flow. Must include at least one entry node (isEntryNode: true). Each node can have a tool configuration and is connected to other nodes via edges

agentName.description: New name for the agent. Leave undefined to keep the current name

agentDescription.description: New description for the agent. Leave undefined to keep the current description
agentDescription.example: An improved agent that fetches cryptocurrency prices with better error handling

settings.description: Updated configuration settings. Leave undefined to keep current settings

nodes.description: The complete updated list of nodes for the agent graph. This replaces all existing nodes - provide the full node structure including any unchanged nodes

agentToolConfigurationId.description: UUID of the agent tool configuration.

toolConfiguration.description: Tool configuration for this chat tool.

isEnabled.description: Whether this chat tool is enabled.

askForConfirmation.description: Whether to ask for user confirmation before executing this tool.

success.description: Whether the skill was imported successfully

destination.description: The destination path or identifier where the skill was imported

error.description: Error message if the import failed
